source.text: בֶּן־שְׁתֵּ֨ים עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֥ם אִמּ֖וֹ חֶפְצִי־בָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A son of two [and] ten year[s was] Manasseh when he became king, and fifty and five year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem; and [the] name of his mother [was] Hephzibah.

en.L: Manasseh [was] a son of twelve years when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother [was] Hephzibah.
en.B: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Hephzibah.
en.R: Manasseh became king at the age of twelve, and he ruled in Jerusalem for fifty-five years. His mother was Hephzibah.

es.L: Hijo de doce años [era] Manasés cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó cincuenta y cinco años en Jerusalén. Y el nombre de su madre [era] Hepsiba.
es.B: Manasés tenía doce años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó cincuenta y cinco años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Hepsiba.
es.R: Manasés comenzó a reinar a los doce años, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante cincuenta y cinco años. Su madre se llamaba Hepsiba.

fr.L: Manassé avait douze ans quand il devint roi, et il régna cinquante-cinq ans à Jérusalem. Et le nom de sa mère [était] Hephtsiba.
fr.B: Manassé avait douze ans quand il devint roi, et il régna cinquante-cinq ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Hephtsiba.
fr.R: Manassé avait douze ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant cinquante-cinq ans. Sa mère s’appelait Hephtsiba.

sw.L: Manase [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka kumi na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka hamsini na mitano huko Yerusalemu. Na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Hefsiba.
sw.B: Manase alikuwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka hamsini na mitano huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Hefsiba.
sw.R: Manase alianza kutawala akiwa na umri wa miaka kumi na miwili, naye akatawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka hamsini na mitano. Mama yake aliitwa Hefsiba.

vi.L: Ma-na-se [được] mười hai tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì năm mươi lăm năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ ông [là] Hép-si-ba.
vi.B: Ma-na-se được mười hai tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì năm mươi lăm năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Hép-si-ba.
vi.R: Ma-na-se lên làm vua lúc mười hai tuổi, và ông cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem năm mươi lăm năm. Mẹ vua tên là Hép-si-ba.

ko.L: 므낫세가 왕이 되었을 때 12세[였고], 예루살렘에서 55년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 헵시바였다.
ko.B: 므낫세는 12세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 55년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 헵시바였다.
ko.R: 므낫세는 12세에 왕이 되었고, 예루살렘에서 55년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 헵시바였다.

pt.L: Manassés [tinha] doze anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou cinquenta e cinco anos em Jerusalém. E o nome da sua mãe [era] Hefzibá.
pt.B: Manassés tinha doze anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou cinquenta e cinco anos em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Hefzibá.
pt.R: Manassés tinha doze anos quando se tornou rei, e governou em Jerusalém durante cinquenta e cinco anos. A sua mãe era Hefzibá.

decisions.choice: a son of twelve years: twelve years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years, as in 8:17.

decisions.choice: fifty-five years: the longest reign of any king of Judah or Israel
decisions.reason: Manasseh followed his father Hezekiah (20:21). His reign is the longest in Kings, and the same verse that gives it its length opens the worst account of any king of Judah. The years may include a time when he shared the throne with his father, since Hezekiah was given fifteen more years after his illness (20:6) and Manasseh was only twelve when he became king.

decisions.choice: Hephzibah: the queen mother, whose name means "my delight is in her"
decisions.reason: As for every king of Judah, the formula names the king's mother (8:26). Her name is a sentence, "my delight is in her"; Isaiah 62:4 uses the same words as a new name for Jerusalem. The written text divides the name into two words and the scribes marked it to be read as one; the name is the same.

decisions.choice: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he reigned fifty-five years
decisions.reason: The wording kept for the accession formula throughout Kings (8:17).

decisions.choice: "Hijo de doce años era" (L); "tenía doce años cuando comenzó a reinar" (B); "Hepsiba"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "son of twelve years", as the English Literal does here; Balanced keeps the terms note's formula. "Hepsiba" is the usual Spanish form.

decisions.choice: Manassé; Hephtsiba
decisions.reason: Manassé as the terms note sets; the queen mother's name in the usual French transcription (ts for the Hebrew tsade).

decisions.choice: Manassés [tinha] doze anos quando começou a reinar (L); A sua mãe se chamava (B); Hefzibá
decisions.reason: The accession formula keeps the wording 1 Kings 22:42 sets for the book at each level, with the age given with "ter" (m1), bracketed at Literal. "Manassés" as the Old Testament names have it, and the queen mother (m3) is "Hefzibá", as Portuguese writes the sounds of the name.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּתֽוֹעֲבֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, according to [the] abominations of the nations which dispossessed Yahweh from before [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, according to the abominations of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out before the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, following the detestable practices of the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had driven out ahead of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil. He copied the disgusting things that the nations had done before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} forced them out of the land for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, conforme a las abominaciones de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, siguiendo las prácticas detestables de las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había expulsado de delante de los israelitas.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba. Imitó las cosas repugnantes que hacían las naciones antes de que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} las echara de la tierra para dar lugar a los israelitas.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon les abominations des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dépossédées devant les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon les pratiques abominables des nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassées devant les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais. Il a imité les choses dégoûtantes que faisaient les peuples que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait chassés du pays pour les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sawasawa na machukizo ya mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akifuata desturi za kuchukiza za mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyafukuza mbele ya Waisraeli.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya. Aliiga mambo ya kuchukiza yaliyofanywa na mataifa kabla {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hajayafukuza kutoka katika nchi kwa ajili ya Waisraeli.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo các điều ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi khỏi trước mặt con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo những thói ghê tởm của các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đuổi đi trước mặt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Ông làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác. Ông bắt chước những việc ghê tởm mà các dân tộc đã làm trước khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đuổi họ ra khỏi xứ để nhường chỗ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 가증한 일들을 따라 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손 앞에서 쫓아내신 민족들의 역겨운 관습을 따라 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 사람들을 위해 그 땅에서 쫓아내신 민족들이 하던 끔찍한 일들을 그대로 따라 했다.

pt.L: E fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, conforme as abominações das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado de diante dos filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, seguindo as coisas abomináveis das nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado de diante dos israelitas.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau. Imitou as coisas abomináveis que faziam as nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha expulsado da terra para dar lugar aos israelitas.

decisions.choice: did what was evil in Yahweh's eyes: the bad verdict
decisions.reason: The verdict of the regnal formula, as at 8:18. Manasseh's father Hezekiah had received the best verdict of all (18:3-5); the son receives the worst.

decisions.choice: abominations: practices Yahweh detests
decisions.reason: The word is used for what is utterly offensive to Yahweh, especially the worship and customs of the Canaanite nations. Deuteronomy 18:9-12 uses it of the very practices listed in verses 3-6.

decisions.choice: the nations Yahweh drove out: Judah takes up the sins for which the land was taken from them
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 14:24, the nations lost the land because of these practices (Leviticus 18:24-28; Deuteronomy 9:4-5). If Judah does the same, it faces the same end, as verses 10-15 announce.

decisions.choice: did the evil in [the] eyes of / did what was evil in the sight of / did what the LORD said was evil
decisions.reason: The verdict formula, worded the same way at each level throughout Kings.

decisions.choice: abominations (Literal); detestable practices (Balanced); disgusting things (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 14:24. Readable says "out of the land" for "from before", as there.

decisions.choice: "hizo lo malo a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "hizo lo que el SEÑOR reprueba" (R); "abominaciones" (L); "prácticas detestables" (B); "cosas repugnantes" (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula keeps the terms note's wording at each level, and the word for what Yahweh loathes keeps the wording used at 16:3.

decisions.choice: fez o mal aos olhos do SENHOR (L), o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR (B), o que o SENHOR considerava mau (R); abominações (L), coisas abomináveis (B, R)
decisions.reason: The bad verdict keeps the wording 1 Kings 15:26 and 16:30 set for the book at each level, and the abominations (m2) the words of 16:3 and 1 Kings 14:24 in Portuguese, so that the reader hears Ahaz's sin again.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender setting
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de Israel
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms set it, and 1 Kings 21:26 in Portuguese: "os filhos de Israel" at Literal and "os israelitas" at Balanced and Readable, with no gender setting where the English has one, since Portuguese "filhos" and "israelitas" already include women.

source.text: וַיָּ֗שָׁב וַיִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת־הַבָּמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִבַּ֖ד חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֑יו וַיָּ֨קֶם מִזְבְּחֹ֜ת לַבַּ֗עַל וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אֲשֵׁרָה֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה אַחְאָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּשְׁתַּ֨חוּ֙ לְכָל־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he returned and built the high places which had destroyed Hezekiah his father, and he set up altars for the Baal, and he made [an] Asherah, as had done Ahab king of Israel; and he bowed down to all [the] host of the heavens and served them.

en.L: And he again built the high places that Hezekiah his father had destroyed, and he set up altars for the Baal and made an Asherah pole, as Ahab king of Israel had done; and he bowed down to all the host of the heavens and served them.
en.B: He rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had destroyed. He set up altars for Baal and made an Asherah pole, as Ahab king of Israel had done. He bowed down to all the host of heaven and served them.
en.R: He built again the hilltop shrines that his father Hezekiah had torn down. He set up altars to worship Baal, and he made a pole used to worship Asherah, just as Ahab king of Israel had done. He bowed down to the sun, moon and stars and worshiped them.

es.L: Y volvió a edificar los lugares altos que Ezequías su padre había destruido, y levantó altares a Baal, e hizo una Aserá, como había hecho Acab, rey de Israel; y se postró ante todo el ejército de los cielos y les sirvió.
es.B: Reconstruyó los lugares altos que su padre Ezequías había destruido. Levantó altares a Baal e hizo un poste de Aserá, como lo había hecho Acab, rey de Israel. Se postró ante todo el ejército de los cielos y les sirvió.
es.R: Volvió a construir los santuarios sobre las colinas que su padre Ezequías había derribado. Levantó altares para adorar a Baal, e hizo un poste para adorar a Aserá, igual que lo había hecho Acab, rey de Israel. Se inclinó ante el sol, la luna y las estrellas, y los adoró.

fr.L: Et il rebâtit les hauts lieux qu’avait détruits Ézéchias son père, et il éleva des autels au Baal et fit un poteau d’Ashéra, comme avait fait Achab, roi d’Israël ; et il se prosterna devant toute l’armée des cieux et la servit.
fr.B: Il rebâtit les hauts lieux que son père Ézéchias avait détruits. Il éleva des autels à Baal et fit un poteau d’Ashéra, comme l’avait fait Achab, roi d’Israël. Il se prosterna devant toute l’armée des cieux et la servit.
fr.R: Il a reconstruit les sanctuaires sur les collines que son père Ézéchias avait démolis. Il a dressé des autels pour adorer Baal, et il a fait un poteau sacré de la déesse Ashéra, comme Achab, roi d’Israël, l’avait fait. Il s’est mis à genoux devant le soleil, la lune et les étoiles, et il les a adorés.

sw.L: Naye akajenga tena mahali pa juu ambapo Hezekia baba yake alipaharibu, akamsimamishia Baali madhabahu, akafanya mti wa Ashera, kama alivyofanya Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli; akalisujudia jeshi lote la mbinguni, akalitumikia.
sw.B: Alijenga upya mahali pa juu ambapo baba yake Hezekia alipaharibu. Akamjengea Baali madhabahu, akafanya mti wa Ashera, kama Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli alivyofanya. Akalisujudia jeshi lote la mbinguni na kulitumikia.
sw.R: Alijenga tena patakatifu pa kilimani ambapo baba yake Hezekia alipabomoa. Alijenga madhabahu za kumwabudu Baali, akatengeneza nguzo ya kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera, kama Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli alivyofanya. Aliyasujudia jua, mwezi na nyota, akaviabudu.

vi.L: Ông lại xây các nơi cao mà Ê-xê-chia cha ông đã phá hủy, dựng các bàn thờ cho Ba-anh và làm một trụ A-sê-ra, như A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã làm; ông cúi lạy cả cơ binh trên trời và phục vụ chúng.
vi.B: Ông xây lại các nơi cao mà Ê-xê-chia cha ông đã phá hủy. Ông dựng các bàn thờ cho Ba-anh và làm một trụ A-sê-ra, như A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã làm. Ông cúi lạy cả cơ binh trên trời và phục vụ chúng.
vi.R: Ông xây lại các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao mà Ê-xê-chia cha ông đã phá bỏ. Ông dựng các bàn thờ để thờ Ba-anh, và làm một trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra, giống như A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đã làm. Ông cúi lạy mặt trời, mặt trăng và các ngôi sao, và thờ phượng chúng.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그의 아버지 히스기야가 헐어 버린 산당들을 다시 짓고, 바알을 위하여 제단들을 쌓고, 이스라엘 왕 아합이 한 것처럼 아세라 목상을 만들었다. 그리고 그가 하늘의 모든 군대에게 절하고 그것들을 섬겼다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 아버지 히스기야가 헐어 버린 산당들을 다시 세웠다. 그는 이스라엘 왕 아합이 한 것처럼 바알의 제단들을 쌓고 아세라 목상을 만들었다. 그는 하늘의 모든 별에게 절하고 그것들을 섬겼다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 아버지 히스기야가 헐어 버린 산꼭대기 제단들을 다시 지었다. 그는 바알을 섬기는 제단들을 쌓고, 이스라엘 왕 아합이 한 것처럼 아세라를 섬기는 데 쓰는 목상을 만들었다. 그는 해와 달과 별들에게 절하고 그것들을 섬겼다.

pt.L: E voltou a edificar os altos que Ezequias, o seu pai, tinha destruído, e levantou altares para o Baal, e fez um poste de Aserá, como tinha feito Acabe, rei de Israel; e se prostrou diante de todo o exército dos céus e o serviu.
pt.B: Ele reconstruiu os altos que o seu pai Ezequias tinha destruído. Levantou altares para Baal e fez um poste de Aserá, como Acabe, rei de Israel, tinha feito. Prostrou-se diante de todo o exército dos céus e o serviu.
pt.R: Ele construiu de novo os santuários no alto dos morros que o seu pai Ezequias tinha derrubado. Levantou altares para adorar o deus Baal e fez um poste usado para adorar a deusa Aserá, como Acabe, rei de Israel, tinha feito. Ele se curvou diante do sol, da lua e das estrelas e os adorou.

decisions.choice: he returned and built: he rebuilt
decisions.reason: "Returned and built" is a Hebrew way of saying "built again". Manasseh undid his father's reform, in which Hezekiah had removed the high places (18:4, 22).

decisions.choice: an Asherah pole, as Ahab king of Israel had done
decisions.reason: Ahab had set up Baal's altar and made the Asherah pole in Samaria (1 Kings 16:32-33). Kings has called Ahab the worst of Israel's kings; now Judah's king is set beside him. The comparison prepares for verse 13, where Jerusalem will be judged by "the plumb line of the house of Ahab". Asherah was a Canaanite goddess, and her symbol was a wooden pole or tree set up beside an altar.

decisions.choice: the host of the heavens: the sun, moon and stars worshiped as gods
decisions.reason: The "host" or army of the heavens is the sun, moon and stars (Deuteronomy 4:19). Israel was forbidden to bow down to them (Deuteronomy 17:3). Their worship was widespread in Assyria, whose vassal Judah was in Manasseh's day, and the northern kingdom had fallen partly for it (17:16). Josiah later removes it (23:4-5).

decisions.choice: high places, Asherah pole (Literal, Balanced); hilltop shrines, a pole used to worship Asherah (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for these words in Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: the sun, moon and stars
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the host of heaven" means (m3), as Deuteronomy 17:3 does.

decisions.choice: "lugares altos", "una Aserá" (L); "un poste de Aserá" (B); "el ejército de los cielos" (L, B); "el sol, la luna y las estrellas" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording at each level, as in 17:16; Readable names what the host of heaven means (m3).

decisions.choice: os altos (L, B), os santuários no alto dos morros (R); o poste de Aserá (L, B), um poste usado para adorar a deusa Aserá (R); o Baal (L), Baal (B), o deus Baal (R)
decisions.reason: The high places, the Asherah pole and Baal keep the words 12:4, 13:6 and 1 Kings 16:31-33 set for the book at each level, so that the reader sees Manasseh doing what Ahab did (m2).

decisions.choice: o exército dos céus (L, B); o sol, a lua e as estrelas (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also verse 5; 17:16; 23:4-5): the stars worshiped as gods (m3) are "o exército dos céus" at Literal and Balanced, the words of 1 Kings 22:19 and Deuteronomy 17:3 in Portuguese, in the singular, so the pronoun after it is "o"; Readable names the sun, moon and stars, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וּבָנָ֥ה מִזְבְּחֹ֖ת בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת־שְׁמִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he built altars in [the] house of Yahweh, of which said Yahweh, In Jerusalem I will put my name.

en.L: And he built altars in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, of which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said, "In Jerusalem I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name."
en.B: He built altars in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the house about which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said, "In Jerusalem I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name."
en.R: He even built altars inside the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. This was the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken of when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name in Jerusalem."

es.L: Y edificó altares en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, de la cual {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho: «En Jerusalén pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre».
es.B: Construyó altares en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, la casa de la que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho: «En Jerusalén pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre».
es.R: Hasta construyó altares dentro del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Ese era el lugar del que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hablado cuando dijo: «Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre en Jerusalén».

fr.L: Et il bâtit des autels dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit : « C’est à Jérusalem que je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. »
fr.B: Il bâtit des autels dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, cette maison dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit : « C’est à Jérusalem que je placerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. »
fr.R: Il a même construit des autels à l’intérieur du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. C’était l’endroit dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait parlé quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dit : « Je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom à Jérusalem. »

sw.L: Naye akajenga madhabahu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema habari zake, "Katika Yerusalemu nitaliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}."
sw.B: Alijenga madhabahu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nyumba ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema habari zake, "Katika Yerusalemu nitaliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}."
sw.R: Hata alijenga madhabahu ndani ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hapo ndipo mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema habari zake aliposema, "Nitaliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} katika Yerusalemu."

vi.L: Ông xây các bàn thờ trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán: "Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Ông xây các bàn thờ trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là nhà mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán: "Tại Giê-ru-sa-lem {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Ông còn xây các bàn thờ ngay trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Đây là nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nói đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: "Ta sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 제단들을 쌓았다. 그 집에 대하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 "예루살렘에 내가 내 이름을 두겠다" 하고 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 제단들을 쌓았다. 그 집은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 "내가 예루살렘에 내 이름을 두겠다" 하고 말씀하신 곳이었다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 안에도 제단들을 쌓았다. 그곳은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 "내가 예루살렘에 내 이름을 두겠다" 하고 말씀하신 곳이었다.

pt.L: E edificou altares na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, da qual {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito: "Em Jerusalém porei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome."
pt.B: Ele construiu altares na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, a casa da qual {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito: "Em Jerusalém porei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome."
pt.R: Ele chegou a construir altares dentro do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Era desse lugar que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha falado quando disse: "Vou pôr o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome em Jerusalém."

decisions.choice: In Jerusalem I will put my name: the promise about the temple
decisions.reason: Yahweh had chosen Jerusalem as the place for his name (1 Kings 8:29; 9:3; 11:36; Deuteronomy 12:5, 11). To put his name there is to claim the place as his own and to be present there to hear prayer. Manasseh sets up altars for other gods in the very house that bears Yahweh's name.

decisions.choice: altars: the altars for the host of heaven of verse 5
decisions.reason: Verse 5 says what these altars were for. Verse 4 first names the outrage, that they stood in Yahweh's own house, and verse 5 adds whom they served and where in the temple they stood.

decisions.choice: the house about which (Balanced); This was the place ... spoken of (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced repeats "the house" so that "about which" plainly refers to the temple and not to Yahweh. Readable makes the relative clause a sentence of its own and adds "even" for the shock of the act.

decisions.choice: aliposema (no free pronoun for "he")
decisions.reason: The English Readable spans "he"; Swahili carries it in the verb prefix, which takes no span.

decisions.choice: porei o meu nome (L, B); Vou pôr o meu nome (R)
decisions.reason: The promise (m1) keeps the "pôr ... o meu nome" of 1 Kings 9:3 and 11:36 in Portuguese at every level, since Readable can keep the plain words here where the English keeps them.

source.text: וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לְכָל־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בִּשְׁתֵּ֖י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he built altars to all [the] host of the heavens in [the] two courts of [the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And he built altars to all the host of the heavens in the two courts of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: He built altars to all the host of heaven in the two courtyards of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: In both courtyards of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, he built altars to worship the sun, moon and stars.

es.L: Y edificó altares a todo el ejército de los cielos en los dos atrios de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Construyó altares a todo el ejército de los cielos en los dos atrios de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: En los dos atrios del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} construyó altares para adorar al sol, la luna y las estrellas.

fr.L: Et il bâtit des autels à toute l’armée des cieux dans les deux cours de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il bâtit des autels à toute l’armée des cieux dans les deux cours de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Dans les deux cours du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, il a construit des autels pour adorer le soleil, la lune et les étoiles.

sw.L: Naye akalijengea jeshi lote la mbinguni madhabahu katika nyua mbili za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Alilijengea jeshi lote la mbinguni madhabahu katika nyua mbili za nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Katika nyua zote mbili za hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alijenga madhabahu za kuabudu jua, mwezi na nyota.

vi.L: Ông xây các bàn thờ cho cả cơ binh trên trời trong hai sân của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ông xây các bàn thờ cho cả cơ binh trên trời trong hai sân của nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Trong cả hai sân của đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ông xây các bàn thờ để thờ mặt trời, mặt trăng và các ngôi sao.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 두 뜰에 하늘의 모든 군대를 위한 제단들을 쌓았다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집의 두 뜰에 하늘의 모든 별을 섬기는 제단들을 쌓았다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전의 두 뜰에 해와 달과 별들을 섬기는 제단들을 쌓았다.

pt.L: E edificou altares a todo o exército dos céus nos dois pátios da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Construiu altares a todo o exército dos céus nos dois pátios da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Nos dois pátios do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, ele construiu altares para adorar o sol, a lua e as estrelas.

decisions.choice: the two courts of the house of Yahweh: the inner and the outer court
decisions.reason: Solomon's temple had an inner court for the priests, where the altar of burnt offering stood, and an outer court (1 Kings 6:36; 7:12). Manasseh filled both with altars to the stars. Josiah later tears them down (23:12).

decisions.choice: the host of the heavens: the sun, moon and stars
decisions.reason: As in verse 3.

decisions.choice: the sun, moon and stars
decisions.reason: As in verse 3.

source.text: וְהֶעֱבִ֤יר אֶת־בְּנוֹ֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְעוֹנֵ֣ן וְנִחֵ֔שׁ וְעָ֥שָׂה א֖וֹב וְיִדְּעֹנִ֑ים הִרְבָּ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִֽיס׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made pass his son through the fire, and he practiced soothsaying and interpreted omens, and he dealt with [a] medium and spiritists; he increased to do the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, to provoke [him].

en.L: And he made his son pass through the fire, and he practiced soothsaying and interpreted omens, and he dealt with a medium and spiritists. He did much evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, provoking [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] to anger.
en.B: He made his son pass through the fire, practiced fortune-telling and read omens, and consulted a medium and spiritists. He did much evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, provoking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to anger.
en.R: He burned his own son in the fire as a sacrifice. He told fortunes and read signs to know the future, and he asked mediums and spiritists to get messages from spirits. He did many things that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said were evil, and this made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} angry.

es.L: E hizo pasar a su hijo por el fuego, y practicó la hechicería y la interpretación de agüeros, y trató con médium y espiritistas. Multiplicó el hacer lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para provocar[{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] a ira.
es.B: Hizo pasar a su hijo por el fuego, practicó la adivinación y leyó presagios, y consultó a médiums y espiritistas. Hizo mucho mal a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, provocándo{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} a ira.
es.R: Quemó a su propio hijo en el fuego como sacrificio. Practicó la adivinación y leyó señales para conocer el futuro, y consultó a médiums y espiritistas para recibir mensajes de los espíritus. Hizo muchas cosas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, y esto {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hizo enojar.

fr.L: Et il fit passer son fils par le feu, et il pratiqua la sorcellerie et la divination, et il établit une nécromancienne et des devins. Il multiplia le mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour [{{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}]irriter.
fr.B: Il fit passer son fils par le feu, pratiqua la sorcellerie et chercha des présages, et il consulta des nécromanciens et des devins. Il fit beaucoup de mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, provoquant ainsi {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.
fr.R: Il a brûlé son propre fils dans le feu, en sacrifice. Il a pratiqué la magie et il a cherché des signes pour connaître l’avenir. Il a demandé à des gens qui interrogent les morts et à des devins de lui transmettre des messages des esprits. Il a fait beaucoup de choses que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvaises, et cela {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a mis en colère.

sw.L: Naye akampitisha mwanawe motoni, akatumia uchawi, akatazama ishara, akashughulika na mwenye pepo wa mizimu na wapiga ramli. Akazidi kufanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili [kumkasirisha].
sw.B: Alimpitisha mwanawe motoni, akabashiri na kutazama ishara, akawaendea wanaowaita wafu na wapiga ramli. Alizidi kufanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akamkasirisha.
sw.R: Alimchoma mwanawe mwenyewe motoni kuwa dhabihu. Alibashiri na kutazama ishara ili kujua yatakayotokea, akawaendea wanaowaita wafu na wapiga ramli ili kupata ujumbe kutoka kwa mizimu. Alifanya mambo mengi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyaona kuwa mabaya, na hayo yakamkasirisha.

vi.L: Ông cho con trai mình đi qua lửa, làm phép bói, xem điềm, giao thiệp với đồng bóng và thầy đồng. Ông làm nhiều điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chọc giận [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}].
vi.B: Ông cho con trai mình đi qua lửa, làm bói toán, xem điềm, và cầu hỏi đồng bóng, thầy đồng. Ông làm nhiều điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ông thiêu chính con trai mình trong lửa để làm sinh tế. Ông bói toán và xem điềm để biết tương lai, và nhờ đồng bóng, thầy đồng để nhận lời từ các vong linh. Ông làm nhiều điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, và điều này khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 자기 아들을 불 가운데로 지나가게 하고, 점을 치고 징조를 풀고, 혼백을 불러내는 자와 영매들과 어울렸다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 많이 하여 [그분을] 노엽게 했다.
ko.B: 그는 자기 아들을 불 가운데로 지나가게 하고, 점을 치고 징조를 살피며, 혼백을 불러내는 자와 영매들에게 물었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 많이 하여 그분의 진노를 일으켰다.
ko.R: 그는 자기 아들을 불에 태워 제물로 바쳤다. 그는 점을 치고 앞날을 알려고 징조를 살폈다. 그는 죽은 사람의 영에게서 말을 들으려고 혼백을 불러내는 사람들에게 물었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 많이 했고, 그래서 그분을 화나시게 했다.

pt.L: E fez o seu filho passar pelo fogo, e praticou agouros, e interpretou presságios, e consultou um médium e espíritas. Fez muito mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, provocando-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} à ira.
pt.B: Ele fez o seu filho passar pelo fogo, leu a sorte, interpretou presságios e consultou médiuns e espíritas. Fez muito mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, provocando-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} à ira.
pt.R: Ele chegou a queimar o seu próprio filho no fogo como sacrifício. Lia a sorte e interpretava sinais para saber o futuro, e pedia a médiuns e espíritas que trouxessem mensagens dos espíritos. Fez muitas coisas que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava más, e isso {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} deixou irado.

decisions.choice: made his son pass through the fire: offered his son as a burnt sacrifice
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 18:10 forbids this rite first in its list, and 12:31 shows that it meant burning children to a god. Ahaz had done it before (16:3), and Kings counts it among the sins for which the north fell (17:17). 2 Chronicles 33:6 says Manasseh did it in the Valley of Ben-hinnom. Josiah later defiles the place where it was done (23:10).

decisions.choice: soothsaying, omens, mediums and spiritists: the practices Deuteronomy 18:10-11 forbids
decisions.reason: The words are those of Deuteronomy 18:10-11. The first may be telling fortunes by reading the clouds; the second is reading omens (Genesis 44:5). The medium and the spiritist are people who claimed to call up the spirits of the dead or to gain hidden knowledge from them (Leviticus 19:31; 1 Samuel 28:7). "Dealt with" may mean that he appointed such people at his court; Josiah later removes them (23:24).

decisions.choice: he did much evil, to provoke: the language of Deuteronomy's warnings
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 4:25 and 31:29 warn that Israel would do evil in Yahweh's eyes and provoke him to anger, and that exile would follow. Kings uses the same words of Manasseh, and the sentence of exile comes in verses 10-15.

decisions.choice: soothsaying, interpreted omens, medium, spiritists (Literal); fortune-telling, read omens (Balanced); told fortunes, read signs to know the future (Readable)
decisions.reason: The words used for these practices in Deuteronomy 18:10-11 at each level, with "soothsaying" kept at Literal for the first. Readable explains each practice as it does there.

decisions.choice: him
decisions.reason: The verb "provoke to anger" has no object in Hebrew; the object is Yahweh. Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: burned ... in the fire as a sacrifice
decisions.reason: Readable says what "pass through the fire" meant, as at Deuteronomy 18:10.

decisions.choice: "hechicería", "agüeros", "médium", "espiritistas" (L); "adivinación", "presagios" (B); plain explanations (R)
decisions.reason: The words for the practices of Deuteronomy 18:10-11 follow the English at each level; Readable explains them, and says what "pass through the fire" meant, as at 16:3.

decisions.choice: "sorcellerie, divination, nécromancienne, devins" (L); "nécromanciens et devins" (B); "gens qui interrogent les morts" (R)
decisions.reason: The practices Deuteronomy 18:10-11 forbids (m2); French uses its traditional words at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says what the mediums did.

decisions.choice: mwenye pepo wa mizimu (Literal); wanaowaita wafu na wapiga ramli (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Mediums and spiritists in the wording settled in 1 Samuel 28 and Leviticus. The English "him" is the object marker "-m-" in Swahili and takes no span.

decisions.choice: phép bói, xem điềm, đồng bóng, thầy đồng (L); bói toán (B, R)
decisions.reason: These practices keep one Vietnamese word each; Readable says what the mediums were for, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "점을 치다", "징조를 풀다/살피다", "혼백을 불러내는 자", "영매"

source.text: וַיָּ֕שֶׂם אֶת־פֶּ֥סֶל הָאֲשֵׁרָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה בַּבַּ֗יִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־דָּוִד֙ וְאֶל־שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֔וֹ בַּבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֜ה וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֨רְתִּי֙ מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he set [the] image of the Asherah that he had made in the house of which said Yahweh to David and to Solomon his son, In the house the this and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen from all [the] tribes of Israel, I will put my name for ever;

en.L: And he set the carved image of the Asherah that he had made in the house of which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said to David and to Solomon his son, "In this house and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel, I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name forever.
en.B: He placed the carved Asherah image he had made in the house about which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said to David and to his son Solomon, "In this house, and in Jerusalem, the city I chose from among all the tribes of Israel, I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name forever.
en.R: He made a carved statue of the goddess Asherah and set it up in the temple. This was the temple {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken about to David and his son Solomon. He had said, "I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name in this temple and in Jerusalem forever. I chose Jerusalem out of all the tribes of Israel.

es.L: Y puso la imagen tallada de la Aserá que había hecho en la casa de la cual {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho a David y a Salomón su hijo: «En esta casa y en Jerusalén, que he escogido de entre todas las tribus de Israel, pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre para siempre;
es.B: Colocó la imagen tallada de Aserá que había hecho en la casa de la que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho a David y a su hijo Salomón: «En esta casa, y en Jerusalén, la ciudad que escogí de entre todas las tribus de Israel, pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre para siempre;
es.R: Hizo una estatua tallada de la diosa Aserá y la puso en el templo. Ese era el templo del que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hablado a David y a su hijo Salomón. Les había dicho: «Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre en este templo y en Jerusalén para siempre. Escogí a Jerusalén de entre todas las tribus de Israel.

fr.L: Et il plaça l’image sculptée d’Ashéra qu’il avait faite dans la maison dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit à David et à Salomon son fils : « Dans cette maison et à Jérusalem, que j’ai choisie parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël, je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom pour toujours ;
fr.B: Il plaça la statue d’Ashéra qu’il avait sculptée dans la maison dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit à David et à son fils Salomon : « Dans cette maison, et à Jérusalem, la ville que j’ai choisie parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël, je placerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom pour toujours.
fr.R: Il a fabriqué une statue sculptée de la déesse Ashéra et l’a installée dans le temple. C’était le temple dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait parlé à David et à son fils Salomon. Il avait dit : « Je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom dans ce temple et à Jérusalem pour toujours. J’ai choisi Jérusalem parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël.

sw.L: Naye akaweka sanamu ya kuchonga ya Ashera aliyoifanya katika nyumba ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemwambia Daudi na Sulemani mwanawe habari zake, "Katika nyumba hii na katika Yerusalemu, niliouchagua katika makabila yote ya Israeli, nitaliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} milele.
sw.B: Aliweka sanamu ya kuchonga ya Ashera aliyoifanya ndani ya nyumba ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemwambia Daudi na mwanawe Sulemani habari zake, "Katika nyumba hii, na katika Yerusalemu, mji niliouchagua katikati ya makabila yote ya Israeli, nitaliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} milele.
sw.R: Alitengeneza sanamu ya kuchonga ya mungu wa kike Ashera, akaisimamisha hekaluni. Hilo ndilo hekalu ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemwambia Daudi na mwanawe Sulemani habari zake. Alikuwa amesema, "Nitaliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} katika hekalu hili na katika Yerusalemu milele. Niliuchagua Yerusalemu katika makabila yote ya Israeli.

vi.L: Ông đặt tượng chạm của A-sê-ra mà ông đã làm trong nhà mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với Đa-vít và Sa-lô-môn con trai người: "Trong nhà này và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, thành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn giữa mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến đời đời.
vi.B: Ông đặt tượng chạm A-sê-ra mà ông đã làm trong nhà mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với Đa-vít và Sa-lô-môn con trai người: "Trong nhà này và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, thành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn giữa mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ông làm một tượng chạm nữ thần A-sê-ra và đặt nó trong đền thờ. Đây là đền thờ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nói đến với Đa-vít và Sa-lô-môn con trai người. Ngài đã phán: "Ta sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong đền thờ này và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem đến đời đời. Ta đã chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem giữa mọi chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 자기가 만든 아세라의 새긴 상을 그 집에 세웠다. 그 집에 대하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗과 그의 아들 솔로몬에게 말씀하셨다. "이 집과, 내가 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데서 택한 예루살렘에 내가 내 이름을 영원히 두겠다.
ko.B: 그는 자기가 만든 아세라의 새긴 상을 그 집에 세웠다. 그 집은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗과 그의 아들 솔로몬에게 이렇게 말씀하신 곳이었다. "이 집과, 내가 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데서 택한 성 예루살렘에 내가 내 이름을 영원히 두겠다.
ko.R: 그는 아세라 여신의 상을 새겨 만들어서 성전 안에 세웠다. 그 성전은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗과 그의 아들 솔로몬에게 말씀하신 바로 그곳이었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이렇게 말씀하셨다. "내가 이 성전과 예루살렘에 내 이름을 영원히 두겠다. 나는 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데서 예루살렘을 택했다.

pt.L: E pôs a imagem esculpida de Aserá, que tinha feito, na casa da qual {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito a Davi e a Salomão, o seu filho: "Nesta casa e em Jerusalém, que escolhi dentre todas as tribos de Israel, porei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome para sempre.
pt.B: Ele colocou a imagem esculpida de Aserá que tinha feito na casa da qual {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito a Davi e ao seu filho Salomão: "Nesta casa e em Jerusalém, a cidade que escolhi dentre todas as tribos de Israel, porei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome para sempre.
pt.R: Ele fez uma estátua esculpida da deusa Aserá e a colocou no templo. Era desse templo que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha falado a Davi e ao seu filho Salomão. Ele tinha dito: "Vou pôr o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome neste templo e em Jerusalém para sempre. Escolhi Jerusalém dentre todas as tribos de Israel.

decisions.choice: the carved image of the Asherah: an idol of the goddess herself
decisions.reason: In verse 3 Manasseh made an Asherah pole; here it is a carved image of Asherah, perhaps the same object or a statue of the goddess. He set it inside the temple, where the ark had stood for Yahweh's presence. 23:6 tells how Josiah brought it out and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

decisions.choice: in this house and in Jerusalem ... I will put my name forever: Yahweh's promise to David and Solomon
decisions.reason: The words recall what Yahweh said of the temple when Solomon dedicated it (1 Kings 8:16, 29; 9:3) and of Jerusalem as the city he chose (1 Kings 11:13, 32, 36). The promise was given with a condition (1 Kings 9:4-9), and verse 8 recalls it. The image stands where Yahweh's name was to stand forever.

decisions.choice: forever: the quotation runs on into verse 8
decisions.reason: The sentence goes on into verse 8, which adds the second half of Yahweh's word: the promise that Israel would stay in the land, and its condition.

decisions.choice: a carved statue of the goddess Asherah
decisions.reason: Readable says that Asherah was a goddess and splits Yahweh's words into two sentences.

decisions.choice: house (Literal, Balanced); temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in Kings, Readable says "temple" for Yahweh's "house".

decisions.choice: a imagem esculpida de Aserá (L, B); uma estátua esculpida da deusa Aserá (R)
decisions.reason: The carved image (m1) is "imagem esculpida", the word for a carved idol in the commandment of Exodus 20:4 in Portuguese; Readable says "estátua" and names Asherah as a goddess, as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: and not I will add to make wander [the] foot of Israel from the ground which I gave to their fathers, only if they will keep to do according to all that I commanded them and according to all the law which commanded them my servant Moses.

en.L: And I will not again make the foot of Israel wander from the land that I gave to their fathers, if only they are careful to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} slave Moses commanded them."
en.B: And I will not again make the feet of Israel wander from the land I gave to their ancestors, if only they will be careful to do all that I have commanded them, all the law that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Moses commanded them."
en.R: I will not make the people of Israel wander away from the land I gave their ancestors again. But they must be careful to obey everything I have commanded them. They must obey all the laws that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Moses gave them."

es.L: y no volveré a hacer andar errante el pie de Israel fuera de la tierra que di a sus padres, con tal que cuiden de hacer conforme a todo lo que les he mandado, y conforme a toda la ley que les mandó {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Moisés».
es.B: y no volveré a hacer que los pies de Israel anden errantes fuera de la tierra que di a sus antepasados, con tal que cuiden de cumplir todo lo que les he mandado, toda la ley que les mandó {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Moisés».
es.R: No volveré a hacer que el pueblo de Israel ande errante, lejos de la tierra que di a sus antepasados. Pero ellos tienen que cuidar de obedecer todo lo que les he mandado. Tienen que obedecer todas las leyes que les dio {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Moisés».

fr.L: et je ne ferai plus errer le pied d’Israël loin de la terre que j’ai donnée à leurs pères, pourvu seulement qu’ils veillent à agir selon tout ce que je leur ai prescrit et selon toute la loi que leur a prescrite Moïse, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} esclave. »
fr.B: Je ne ferai plus errer les pas d’Israël loin de la terre que j’ai donnée à leurs ancêtres, pourvu qu’ils veillent à mettre en pratique tout ce que je leur ai prescrit, toute la loi que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Moïse leur a donnée. »
fr.R: Je ne ferai plus partir le peuple d’Israël loin du pays que j’ai donné à ses ancêtres. Mais ils doivent faire attention à obéir à tout ce que je leur ai commandé. Ils doivent obéir à toute la loi que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Moïse leur a donnée. »

sw.L: Wala sitaongeza tena kuutangatangisha mguu wa Israeli kutoka katika nchi niliyowapa baba zao, ikiwa tu watakuwa waangalifu kufanya sawasawa na yote niliyowaamuru, na sawasawa na sheria yote aliyowaamuru mtumwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Musa."
sw.B: Wala sitaifanya tena miguu ya Israeli itangetange kutoka katika nchi niliyowapa babu zao, ikiwa tu watakuwa waangalifu kufanya yote niliyowaamuru, sheria yote aliyowaamuru mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Musa."
sw.R: Sitawafanya tena watu wa Israeli watangetange mbali na nchi niliyowapa babu zao. Lakini lazima wawe waangalifu kutii kila kitu nilichowaamuru. Lazima watii sheria zote ambazo mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Musa aliwapa."

vi.L: Ta sẽ không để chân Y-sơ-ra-ên lưu lạc khỏi đất {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ phụ họ nữa, miễn là họ cẩn thận làm theo mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho họ, và theo cả luật pháp mà đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Môi-se đã truyền cho họ."
vi.B: Ta sẽ không để chân Y-sơ-ra-ên phải lưu lạc khỏi đất {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ nữa, miễn là họ cẩn thận làm theo mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho họ, tức toàn bộ luật pháp mà đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Môi-se đã truyền cho họ."
vi.R: Ta sẽ không để dân Y-sơ-ra-ên phải lưu lạc khỏi đất {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ nữa. Nhưng họ phải cẩn thận vâng giữ mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho họ. Họ phải vâng giữ mọi luật lệ mà đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Môi-se đã ban cho họ."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 내가 그들에게 명령한 모든 것대로, 그리고 내 종 모세가 그들에게 명령한 모든 율법대로 지켜 행하기만 하면, 내가 그들의 조상들에게 준 땅에서 이스라엘의 발이 다시는 떠돌게 하지 않겠다."
ko.B: 그들이 내가 명령한 모든 것, 곧 내 종 모세가 그들에게 명령한 모든 율법을 지켜 행하기만 하면, 내가 그들의 조상들에게 준 땅에서 이스라엘이 다시는 발붙이지 못하고 떠돌게 하지 않겠다."
ko.R: 나는 이스라엘 백성이 내가 그들의 조상들에게 준 땅에서 다시는 쫓겨나 떠돌게 하지 않겠다. 다만 그들은 내가 명령한 모든 것을 잘 지켜야 한다. 내 종 모세가 그들에게 준 모든 율법을 지켜야 한다."

pt.L: E não tornarei a fazer o pé de Israel vaguear para fora da terra que dei aos seus pais, contanto que tenham o cuidado de fazer conforme tudo o que lhes ordenei e conforme toda a Lei que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} escravo Moisés lhes ordenou."
pt.B: E não deixarei mais que os pés de Israel vagueiem longe da terra que dei aos seus antepassados, contanto que tenham o cuidado de cumprir tudo o que lhes ordenei, toda a Lei que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Moisés lhes ordenou."
pt.R: Não vou mais fazer o povo de Israel andar sem rumo, longe da terra que dei aos seus antepassados. Mas eles precisam ter o cuidado de obedecer a tudo o que lhes ordenei. Precisam obedecer a todas as leis que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Moisés lhes deu."

decisions.choice: make the foot of Israel wander: drive Israel from its land
decisions.reason: To make someone's foot wander is to make them homeless, driven from place to place. The promise was that Israel would be settled for good (2 Samuel 7:10). By Manasseh's day the northern tribes had already been carried off (17:6, 23).

decisions.choice: only if they are careful to do: the condition of the promise
decisions.reason: The promise of the land was never without condition (1 Kings 9:4-7; Deuteronomy 28:63-64). The words prepare for verse 9: they did not listen.

decisions.choice: the law that my servant Moses commanded: the law of Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: "Law" (torah) means the whole of Yahweh's instruction given through Moses, as in Deuteronomy 1:5 and 1 Kings 2:3. Moses is called Yahweh's servant as at Joshua 1:2 and 1 Kings 8:53.

decisions.choice: slave (Literal); servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As set for "Moses the servant of the LORD": Literal says "slave", Balanced and Readable "servant".

decisions.choice: feet; ancestors; the people of Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "feet", since English uses the plural for a people's movements, and "ancestors" for "fathers". Readable says "the people of Israel" and splits the condition into separate sentences.

decisions.choice: "mi siervo Moisés"
decisions.reason: God's servant Moses is "siervo" at every level in Spanish, Literal included, as the Psalms terms note sets.

decisions.choice: o meu escravo Moisés (L), o meu servo Moisés (B, R); a Lei (L, B), as leis (R)
decisions.reason: Moses is the LORD's "escravo" at Literal and "servo" at Balanced and Readable, as the Old Testament terms set it; "a Lei" takes a capital as the Law of Moses (m3), and Readable says "as leis", as the English does.

source.text: וְלֹ֖א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַיַּתְעֵ֤ם מְנַשֶּׁה֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֶת־הָרָ֔ע מִן־הַ֨גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הִשְׁמִ֣יד יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And not they listened, and led them astray Manasseh to do the evil more than the nations which destroyed Yahweh from before [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: But they did not listen, and Manasseh led them astray to do evil more than the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had destroyed before the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: But they did not listen. Manasseh led them astray, so that they did more evil than the nations {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had destroyed ahead of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.
en.R: But the people did not listen. Manasseh led them to do wrong. They did even more evil things than the nations {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had wiped out to make room for the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}.

es.L: Pero no escucharon, y Manasés los extravió para que hicieran lo malo más que las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había destruido delante de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Pero no escucharon. Manasés los extravió, de modo que hicieron más mal que las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había destruido delante de los israelitas.
es.R: Pero el pueblo no hizo caso. Manasés los llevó a hacer el mal. Hicieron cosas aún peores que las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había destruido para dar lugar a los israelitas.

decisions.choice: they did not listen: the people share the guilt
decisions.reason: The subject turns from Manasseh to the people. They did not keep the condition of verse 8, so the promise of staying in the land no longer protects them. Yet the king who led them is named as the cause.

decisions.choice: led them astray: made them wander from the right way
decisions.reason: The verb means to cause someone to go astray, like a lost animal. It is the opposite of keeping to the way Yahweh commanded.

decisions.choice: more evil than the nations Yahweh destroyed
decisions.reason: The nations of Canaan were destroyed for their practices (verse 2). Judah now goes beyond them, so it has even less claim to the land than they had.

decisions.choice: to make room for
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what "destroyed before" Israel meant, as at 1 Kings 21:26.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender setting

decisions.choice: by the hand of: through
decisions.reason: "By the hand of" someone means through that person as a go-between, as in 1 Kings 14:18.

decisions.choice: his servants the prophets: the prophets of Manasseh's day, not named
decisions.reason: Kings does not name them. 2 Chronicles 33:10, 18 speaks of the seers who spoke to Manasseh in Yahweh's name. The title "his servants the prophets" recurs in Kings at the fall of each kingdom (17:13, 23; 24:2).

decisions.choice: slaves (Literal); servants (Balanced, Readable)

en.L: "Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, has done evil more than all that the Amorites did who [were] before him, and has made Judah also sin with his idols,
en.B: "Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these detestable things, doing more evil than all that the Amorites did before him, and has also made Judah sin with his idols,
en.R: "Manasseh king of Judah has done these disgusting things. He has done more evil than the Amorites who lived in the land before him. He has also led the people of Judah to sin by worshiping his idols.

es.L: «Por cuanto Manasés, rey de Judá, ha hecho estas abominaciones, y ha hecho lo malo más que todo lo que hicieron los amorreos que [fueron] antes de él, y también ha hecho pecar a Judá con sus ídolos,
es.B: «Por cuanto Manasés, rey de Judá, ha cometido estas prácticas detestables, haciendo más mal que todo lo que hicieron los amorreos antes que él, y también ha hecho pecar a Judá con sus ídolos,
es.R: «Manasés, rey de Judá, ha hecho estas cosas repugnantes. Ha hecho más mal que los amorreos que vivieron en esta tierra antes que él. También ha llevado a la gente de Judá a pecar adorando a sus ídolos.

fr.L: « Parce que Manassé, roi de Juda, a commis ces abominations, qu’il a fait le mal plus que tout ce qu’avaient fait les Amoréens qui [étaient] avant lui, et qu’il a fait pécher Juda aussi par ses idoles,

fr.R: « Manassé, roi de Juda, a fait ces choses dégoûtantes. Il a fait plus de mal que les Amoréens qui vivaient dans le pays avant lui. Il a aussi entraîné le peuple de Juda à pécher en adorant ses idoles.

ko.L: "유다 왕 므낫세가 이 가증한 일들을 행했고, 그보다 먼저 있던 아모리 사람들이 한 모든 것보다 더 악한 일을 행했으며, 그의 우상들로 유다에게도 죄를 짓게 했으므로,
ko.B: "유다 왕 므낫세가 이 역겨운 일들을 저질러, 그보다 앞서 있던 아모리 사람들이 한 모든 일보다 더 악한 일을 하고, 그의 우상들로 유다에게도 죄를 짓게 했으므로,
ko.R: "유다 왕 므낫세가 이런 끔찍한 일들을 했다. 그는 그보다 먼저 이 땅에 살던 아모리 사람들보다 더 악한 일을 했다. 그는 또 유다 백성이 그의 우상들을 섬기게 하여 그들에게 죄를 짓게 했다.

pt.L: "Porque Manassés, rei de Judá, fez estas abominações, fez o mal mais do que tudo o que fizeram os amorreus que [foram] antes dele, e fez também Judá pecar com os seus ídolos,
pt.B: "Porque Manassés, rei de Judá, fez estas coisas abomináveis, fazendo mais mal do que tudo o que os amorreus fizeram antes dele, e levou também Judá a pecar com os seus ídolos,
pt.R: "Manassés, rei de Judá, fez essas coisas abomináveis. Ele fez mais mal do que os amorreus que viviam na terra antes dele. Também levou o povo de Judá a pecar, adorando os seus ídolos.

decisions.choice: the Amorites: the peoples of Canaan before Israel
decisions.reason: As at 1 Kings 21:26, "Amorites" stands for all the nations who lived in the land before Israel (Genesis 15:16). Genesis 15:16 speaks of the Amorites' wrongdoing coming to its full measure before they lost the land; now Judah's king outdoes them.

decisions.choice: idols: a scornful word for false gods
decisions.reason: The word is used in contempt, as at 1 Kings 15:12 and 21:26. It may be related to a word for dung, though its origin is not certain.

decisions.choice: because ... therefore: the charge in verse 11, the sentence in verses 12-15
decisions.reason: The prophets' word has the shape of a judgment speech: first the charge ("because ..."), then the sentence ("therefore ...", verse 12). The sentence runs on into verse 12.

decisions.choice: made Judah also sin: as Jeroboam made Israel sin
decisions.reason: Kings says over and over that Jeroboam "made Israel sin" (1 Kings 14:16; 2 Kings 17:21-22), and the north fell for it. "Also" sets Judah beside Israel: Manasseh has done to Judah what Jeroboam did to Israel.

decisions.choice: detestable things (Balanced); disgusting things (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: separate sentences without "because" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable states the charges as sentences of their own and joins them to the sentence in verse 12 with "So". Readable adds "lived in the land" to say who the Amorites were (m1), and "by worshiping" to say how the idols led Judah to sin.

decisions.choice: "los amorreos"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish name of the peoples of Canaan before Israel (m1).

decisions.choice: hắn for Manasseh in the LORD's judgment
decisions.reason: In the LORD's sentence the condemned king is "hắn", which carries the judgment without the contempt of "nó".

decisions.choice: "...했으므로," ending verse 11 on a connective; verse 12 begins "그러므로"
alternatives: one sentence without the verse break
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "because ... therefore" spans two verses; Korean keeps the cause in verse 11 and the sentence in verse 12. Readable splits it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: os amorreus; fez ... Judá pecar (L), levou ... a pecar (B, R); ídolos
decisions.reason: "Os amorreus" (m1) and "ídolos" (m2) are the words 1 Kings 21:26 uses in Portuguese for the same charge; "fez Judá pecar" (L) and "levou ... a pecar" (B, R) are the words of the refrain on Jeroboam (13:2), so the echo of m4 is heard.

ko.B: 그러므로 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 보아라, 내가 예루살렘과 유다에 재앙을 내리려 한다. 그 소식을 듣는 사람마다 두 귀가 얼얼할 것이다.

pt.B: por isso, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel: Estou para trazer sobre Jerusalém e Judá uma desgraça tal que fará tinir os dois ouvidos de todos os que ouvirem falar dela.

decisions.choice: both ears will tingle: news so dreadful that it stuns the hearer
decisions.reason: The same words were spoken to Samuel about the fall of Eli's house and the loss of the ark (1 Samuel 3:11); Jeremiah 19:3 uses them of Jerusalem again. What once fell on Shiloh and the priests will now fall on Jerusalem itself.

decisions.choice: I am bringing: an action about to happen
decisions.reason: The participle after "look" describes something already set in motion, as in 1 Samuel 3:11.

decisions.choice: everyone who hears of it: the form read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) have a slightly different form of the word "hearing", and the scribes marked another to be read aloud (qere). Both mean everyone who hears of the disaster.

decisions.choice: disaster: harm, calamity
decisions.reason: The word is the same as "evil" in verses 2, 6, 9 and 15. Judah's evil brings evil on it in return: disaster as the fruit of wrong.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD / the LORD says this / This is what the LORD says
decisions.reason: The messenger formula as worded at each level in these books. The tingling ears are worded as in 1 Samuel 3:11 at each level.

decisions.choice: "le zumbarán ambos oídos"
decisions.reason: The tingling ears are kept as a picture at every level, as the English does; "zumbar" is the Spanish for ringing ears.

decisions.choice: "Ainsi parle le SEIGNEUR" (L), "Le SEIGNEUR dit ceci" (B), "Voici ce que dit le SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: The French formula of the Samuel terms note for "Thus says the LORD", one wording per level.

decisions.choice: masikio yatawasha (Literal, Balanced); masikio yatavuma (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew picture of tingling ears, news so dreadful it stuns (meaning decision m1); Readable says the ears will ring.

decisions.choice: "주께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L), "이렇게 말씀하신다" (B), "주께서 하시는 말씀이다" (R), with the honorific
alternatives: "말한다", without -시-, since the formula stands inside God's own speech (verse 10)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula keeps the honorific even inside God's own speech (verse 10), as the terms notes set for the formula through the Prophets and Kings; Isaiah 38:5 = 2 Kings 20:5 is the one recorded exception.

decisions.choice: fará tinir os dois ouvidos (L, B); vai deixar zumbindo os ouvidos (R)
decisions.reason: The tingling ears (m1) keep the words of 1 Samuel 3:11 in Portuguese at each level, so that the judgment on Shiloh is heard again over Jerusalem; the messenger formula keeps the wording 1:4 sets for the book.

source.text: וְנָטִ֣יתִי עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֵ֚ת קָ֣ו שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וְאֶת־מִשְׁקֹ֖לֶת בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וּמָחִ֨יתִי אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־יִמְחֶ֤ה אֶת־הַצַּלַּ֨חַת֙ מָחָ֔ה וְהָפַ֖ךְ עַל־פָּנֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will stretch over Jerusalem [the] line of Samaria and [the] plummet of [the] house of Ahab; and I will wipe Jerusalem as wipes [one] the dish, he wipes and turns [it] on its face.

en.L: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the measuring line of Samaria and the plumb line of the house of Ahab, and I will wipe Jerusalem as one wipes the dish: he wipes [it] and turns [it] over on its face.
en.B: I will stretch over Jerusalem the measuring line used on Samaria and the plumb line used on the house of Ahab. I will wipe Jerusalem clean as someone wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
en.R: I will measure Jerusalem with the same line I used for Samaria and the same plumb line I used for Ahab's family. Jerusalem will meet the same end they did. I will wipe Jerusalem clean, the way someone wipes out a dish and turns it upside down.

es.L: Y extenderé sobre Jerusalén el cordel de Samaria y la plomada de la casa de Acab; y limpiaré a Jerusalén como se limpia un plato: se limpia y se pone boca abajo.
es.B: Extenderé sobre Jerusalén el cordel de medir que usé con Samaria y la plomada que usé con la casa de Acab. Limpiaré a Jerusalén como quien limpia un plato, lo seca y lo pone boca abajo.
es.R: Mediré a Jerusalén con el mismo cordel que usé con Samaria y con la misma plomada que usé con la familia de Acab. Jerusalén tendrá el mismo fin que ellos. Dejaré a Jerusalén limpia, como quien limpia un plato y lo pone boca abajo.

fr.L: Et j’étendrai sur Jérusalem le cordeau de Samarie et le niveau de la maison d’Achab, et j’essuierai Jérusalem comme on essuie le plat : on l’essuie et on le retourne sur sa face.
fr.B: J’étendrai sur Jérusalem le cordeau qui a servi pour Samarie et le fil à plomb qui a servi pour la maison d’Achab. J’essuierai Jérusalem comme on essuie un plat, qu’on essuie puis qu’on retourne.
fr.R: Je mesurerai Jérusalem avec le même cordeau que pour Samarie et le même fil à plomb que pour la famille d’Achab. Jérusalem connaîtra la même fin qu’eux. Je nettoierai Jérusalem comme on essuie un plat avant de le retourner.

sw.L: Nami nitanyoosha juu ya Yerusalemu kamba ya kupimia ya Samaria na timazi ya nyumba ya Ahabu, nami nitaifuta Yerusalemu kama mtu afutavyo sahani: anaifuta na kuipindua kifudifudi.
sw.B: Nitanyoosha juu ya Yerusalemu kamba ya kupimia iliyotumika juu ya Samaria na timazi iliyotumika juu ya nyumba ya Ahabu. Nitaifuta Yerusalemu kabisa kama mtu afutavyo sahani, akaifuta na kuipindua.
sw.R: Nitaipima Yerusalemu kwa kamba ile ile niliyoitumia kwa Samaria, na kwa timazi ile ile niliyoitumia kwa jamaa ya Ahabu. Yerusalemu utapatwa na mwisho ule ule waliopata wao. Nitaifuta Yerusalemu kabisa, kama mtu anavyoifuta sahani na kuipindua.

vi.L: Ta sẽ giăng trên Giê-ru-sa-lem dây đo của Sa-ma-ri và dây dọi của nhà A-háp, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lau sạch Giê-ru-sa-lem như người ta lau cái đĩa: lau rồi úp [nó] xuống.
vi.B: Ta sẽ giăng trên Giê-ru-sa-lem dây đo đã dùng cho Sa-ma-ri và dây dọi đã dùng cho nhà A-háp. Ta sẽ lau sạch Giê-ru-sa-lem như người ta lau một cái đĩa, lau xong rồi úp xuống.
vi.R: Ta sẽ đo Giê-ru-sa-lem bằng chính dây đo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã dùng cho Sa-ma-ri và dây dọi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã dùng cho nhà A-háp. Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ chịu chung số phận với chúng. Ta sẽ lau sạch Giê-ru-sa-lem, như người ta lau sạch một cái đĩa rồi úp nó xuống.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 사마리아를 잰 줄과 아합의 집을 단 추를 예루살렘 위에 펴겠다. 그리고 사람이 그릇을 닦듯이 내가 예루살렘을 닦겠다. 그가 닦고 [그것을] 엎어 놓는다.
ko.B: 내가 사마리아에 썼던 측량줄과 아합의 집에 썼던 다림추를 예루살렘 위에 드리우겠다. 사람이 그릇을 닦아 엎어 놓듯이 내가 예루살렘을 깨끗이 닦아 버리겠다.
ko.R: 나는 사마리아를 잴 때 쓴 줄과 아합 집안을 잴 때 쓴 다림줄로 예루살렘을 재겠다. 예루살렘도 그들과 똑같은 끝을 맞을 것이다. 사람이 그릇을 깨끗이 닦아서 엎어 놓듯이, 내가 예루살렘을 깨끗이 쓸어 버리겠다.

pt.L: E estenderei sobre Jerusalém o prumo de Samaria e o nível da casa de Acabe, e limparei Jerusalém como se limpa um prato: limpa-[o] e [o] vira de boca para baixo.
pt.B: Estenderei sobre Jerusalém o prumo usado em Samaria e o nível usado na casa de Acabe. Limparei Jerusalém como se limpa um prato, limpando-o e virando-o de boca para baixo.
pt.R: Vou medir Jerusalém com o mesmo prumo que usei para Samaria e com o mesmo nível que usei para a família de Acabe. Jerusalém vai ter o mesmo fim que eles tiveram. Vou limpar Jerusalém por completo, como se limpa um prato e se vira de boca para baixo.

decisions.choice: the measuring line of Samaria and the plumb line of the house of Ahab: Jerusalem judged by the standard that brought Samaria and Ahab's house down
decisions.reason: A builder's measuring line and plumb line test whether a wall is straight. Stretched over a city by Yahweh they mean judgment and ruin (Isaiah 34:11; Lamentations 2:8; Amos 7:7-9). Samaria fell to Assyria (17:6) and Ahab's whole house was wiped out (10:10-11); Jerusalem will be measured by the same standard and meet the same end.

decisions.choice: wipe Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, turning it upside down: clear it out completely
decisions.reason: A dish is wiped clean of every scrap and turned over to dry, so that nothing is left in it. Jerusalem will be emptied of its people (verse 14).

decisions.choice: he wipes and turns: the picture of the one who wipes the dish
decisions.reason: The two verbs describe the one wiping the dish, not a second act of Yahweh's, though the picture applies to what Yahweh will do to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: used on
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "used on" to show that Samaria and Ahab's house were measured with these tools, not that the tools belong to them.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem will meet the same end they did
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture of the line and the plumb line and adds a sentence saying what it means (m1).

decisions.choice: "que usé con"
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "que usé con" to show that Samaria and Ahab's house were measured with these tools, as the English adds "used on".

decisions.choice: "cordeau", "niveau" (L), "fil à plomb" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The builder's tools stand for the standard of judgment that brought down Samaria and Ahab's house (m1).

decisions.choice: kamba ya kupimia; timazi
decisions.reason: The builder's measuring line and plumb line, the standard by which Samaria and Ahab's house were judged (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: o prumo de Samaria e o nível da casa de Acabe
alternatives: o cordel de Samaria e o prumo da casa de Acabe
a linha de medir ... o prumo
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the two builder's tools that test whether a wall stands straight (m1) are given the names Brazilian builders use for them, "o prumo" and "o nível", so that the picture of a wall tested and condemned is clear at once; "cordel" is now a rural or literary word. The pairing follows the sense of the picture rather than matching each Hebrew word to one English tool.

decisions.choice: como se limpa um prato ... de boca para baixo
decisions.reason: The dish wiped clean and turned over (m2) is "como se limpa um prato", the everyday Portuguese picture, with "de boca para baixo" for a dish set upside down to dry; Literal brackets the object Portuguese needs.

records.literal_gloss: And I will forsake [the] remnant of my inheritance and give them into [the] hand of their enemies, and they will become plunder and spoil to all their enemies,

en.L: And I will forsake the remnant of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} inheritance and give them into the hand of their enemies, and they will become plunder and spoil to all their enemies,
en.B: I will abandon what is left of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own people and hand them over to their enemies, and they will become plunder and spoil for all their enemies,
en.R: I will abandon those who are left of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own people and hand them over to their enemies. All their enemies will rob them and carry off what they own.

es.L: Y abandonaré el remanente de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} heredad y los entregaré en mano de sus enemigos, y serán presa y despojo para todos sus enemigos,

es.R: Abandonaré a los que quedan de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} propio pueblo y los entregaré a sus enemigos. Todos sus enemigos les robarán y se llevarán lo que tienen.

fr.L: Et j’abandonnerai le reste de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} héritage et je les livrerai dans la main de leurs ennemis, et ils deviendront le butin et la proie de tous leurs ennemis,
fr.B: J’abandonnerai ce qui reste de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} propre peuple et je les livrerai à leurs ennemis ; ils seront le butin et la proie de tous leurs ennemis,
fr.R: J’abandonnerai ceux qui restent de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} propre peuple et je les livrerai à leurs ennemis. Tous leurs ennemis les pilleront et emporteront ce qu’ils possèdent.

sw.L: Nami nitayaacha mabaki ya urithi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, na kuwatia katika mkono wa adui zao, nao watakuwa mawindo na nyara kwa adui zao wote,
sw.B: Nitawaacha wale waliobaki wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mwenyewe na kuwatia mikononi mwa adui zao, nao watakuwa mawindo na nyara kwa adui zao wote,
sw.R: Nitawaacha wale waliobaki wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mwenyewe na kuwatia mikononi mwa adui zao. Adui zao wote watawanyang'anya na kuchukua mali zao.

vi.L: Ta sẽ lìa bỏ phần sót lại của cơ nghiệp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và phó họ vào tay kẻ thù họ; họ sẽ thành mồi cướp và của cướp cho mọi kẻ thù họ,
vi.B: Ta sẽ bỏ mặc những người còn sót lại của dân thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và phó họ cho kẻ thù. Họ sẽ trở thành mồi cướp bóc cho mọi kẻ thù,
vi.R: Ta sẽ bỏ mặc những người còn sót lại của dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và trao họ cho kẻ thù. Mọi kẻ thù sẽ cướp bóc họ và lấy đi những gì họ có.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 내 유업의 남은 자들을 버리고 그들을 그들의 원수들의 손에 넘기겠다. 그래서 그들이 그들의 모든 원수에게 약탈물과 노획물이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 나는 내 백성 가운데 남은 사람들을 버리고 그들을 원수들의 손에 넘기겠다. 그들은 모든 원수에게 약탈과 노략을 당할 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 내 백성 가운데 남은 사람들을 버리고 원수들에게 넘겨주겠다. 그들의 모든 원수가 그들을 털고 그들의 재산을 빼앗아 갈 것이다.

pt.L: E abandonarei o remanescente da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} herança e os entregarei na mão dos seus inimigos, e eles se tornarão presa e despojo para todos os seus inimigos,
pt.B: Abandonarei o que resta do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} próprio povo e o entregarei aos seus inimigos, e eles se tornarão presa e despojo para todos os seus inimigos,
pt.R: Vou abandonar os que restarem do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} próprio povo e entregá-los aos seus inimigos. Todos os inimigos deles vão roubá-los e levar tudo o que eles têm.

decisions.choice: the remnant of my inheritance: Judah, all that is left of Yahweh's own people
decisions.reason: Israel is Yahweh's inheritance, the people he took as his own possession (Deuteronomy 9:29; 32:9; 1 Kings 8:51). After the northern tribes were carried off, Judah was the remnant left (17:18).

decisions.choice: I will forsake: the reverse of an old promise
decisions.reason: Samuel had said that Yahweh would not forsake his people for his great name's sake (1 Samuel 12:22), and Solomon prayed that he would not forsake them (1 Kings 8:57). The same verb now announces that he will leave them to their enemies.

decisions.choice: give them into the hand of their enemies: hand them over to their power
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power, as at 8:20.

decisions.choice: all their enemies: the sentence runs on into verse 15
decisions.reason: Verse 15 gives the reason for the sentence, so the sentence continues there.

decisions.choice: what is left of my own people (Balanced); those who are left of my own people (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the "remnant of my inheritance" is (m1).

decisions.choice: will rob them and carry off what they own
decisions.reason: Readable puts "plunder and spoil" as plain verbs.

decisions.choice: Verse 14 ends a sentence; verse 15 gives the reason with "이는 ... 때문이다"
decisions.reason: Korean puts the main verb at the end, so the Hebrew sentence that runs into verse 15 is split at the verse marker.
